description_summary: Field: gabbrodiorite. Subophitic gabbrodiorite of zoned plagioclase, fresh mon.pyroxene and pale-green hornblende; oxide-dominated accessory mineralisation.

texture: Porphyritic; groundmass subophitic, locally poikilo-ophitic; massive
minerals: Altered plagioclase:65-70; Mon. pyroxene:15-20; Hornblende:8-10; Biotite:5-8; Pyrite:few; Magnetite:2-3; Hematite:few; Ilmenite:few; Goethite:0.5; Apatite:single grains

description_summary: Field: oxidized gabbro? Porphyritic gabbrodiorite (plagioclase phenocrysts 10-15%) with weakly oxidised magnetite-dominated accessory mineralisation; pyrite preserved as relicts in goethite.

minerals: Altered plagioclase:65-70; Mon. pyroxene:15-20; Hornblende:8-10; Biotite:5-8; Magnetite:3-5; Hematite:few; Goethite:few; Pyrite:single grains; Hydrogoethite:few

description_summary: Field: oxidized gabbro? Subophitic gabbrodiorite very similar to 46811/46810; weakly oxidised oxide-dominant mineralisation.
